name: cozy-bump
description: Bump a cozystack monorepo package — detects upstream source, fetches changelog between current and target versions, surfaces breaking changes / deprecations / new required keys, adapts values.yaml and templates, regenerates schema and ApplicationDefinition, runs helm template + lint, commits with Conventional-Commit message, and optionally deploys to a dev cluster via cozyhr suspend + make apply with ttl.sh ephemeral image registry
